policy.pkgdesc: Asyncio-based multidict implementation rebuilt for Strix Halo gfx1151
policy.recipe_notes_override:
This package is the multidict output from the shared `native_wheels` recipe
phase. That phase also builds numpy, sentencepiece, zstandard, asyncpg,
duckdb, PyYAML, psutil, Pillow, uvloop, httptools, msgspec, aiohttp, yarl,
and frozenlist from source with Zen 5 optimization flags, but those outputs
are tracked as separate packages or follow-up package lanes rather than as
dependencies of `python-multidict-gfx1151`.

multidict is part of aiohttp and yarl's native dependency closure and belongs
in the same optimized service/runtime stack.
scaffold_notes: Part of the comprehensive Blackcat aiohttp service dependency closure and consumed by the local yarl and aiohttp packages.
Use the shared native-wheel renderer so amdclang, path remapping, and Zen 5 flags stay aligned with the other native wheel packages.
